garden.label: Garden
garden.blurb: The school garden. Two barns: tame day animals in one, night animals in the other.

school.label: School
school.blurb: Classes, kitchen, potions, library and sparring.
school.hint: The big building west of Town.

upper.label: Upper Floor
upper.blurb: The Dojo (pet training) and the Workshop (the Enchanter).

farm.label: Farm
farm.blurb: Your plots, the pump and the market stall.

town.label: Town
town.blurb: Home. The Tailor changes your ninja colour.

forest.label: Forest
forest.blurb: Trees, the Lumberjack and the Old Fisher.

quarry.label: Quarry
quarry.blurb: Rocks to mine. The Miner fixes and upgrades pickaxes. Surveyor Tam waits by the cave mouth.

cave.label: Caves
cave.blurb: A big dark cave of 8 chambers, bats and Granite. Explore every chamber (a message shows each new one). A pickaxe clears blocked tunnels.
cave.hint: Through the cave mouth in the Quarry. Bring a light.

crystal.label: Crystal Caverns
crystal.blurb: Glimmer Hall, the Moth Garden and the Bat Queen. Many doors lead out of here.

market.label: Shadow Market
market.blurb: Hidden dark-magic market: the Hexsmith (WEAPON upgrades), the Brewer, the Critter Seller and the Charm Seller.
market.hint: A hidden crack in the wall in the top-right corner of the Crystal Caverns (a sign talks about a cold draft). You need the Crystal Lantern from the Bat Queen to see through it.

peaks.label: Frozen Peaks
peaks.blurb: Snow, an Ice Hermit and the island gate to the Ruins.
peaks.hint: A cold passage behind the Bat Queen's roost.

ruins.label: Sunken Ruins
ruins.blurb: Rune stones and the Sea Serpent. A wave-carved arch leads back to the Caverns.
ruins.hint: Across the water from the Frozen Peaks.

desert.label: Desert
desert.blurb: Sand, scorpions and the Scorpion King.
desert.hint: A sealed sandy archway in the Moth Garden. It wants half of a silver Moon Crest.

bazaar.label: Desert Bazaar
bazaar.blurb: The ARMOR smith, the spice seller, the gem trader and the princess.

hollow.label: Cursed Hollow
hollow.blurb: A purple twilight wood. Six fairies are trapped in thorn cages, each guarded by a dark twin.
hollow.hint: West of the Forest, behind a thorn wall. Needs the Fairy Charm.

services.how: Hexsmith at the Shadow Market. Order a weapon, it is ready when you come back.
The smith at the Desert Bazaar. Same deal: order, then return.
The Enchanter in the Workshop (upstairs at school).
The market stall shopkeeper.
The Miner, so you do not have to walk back.
The Brewer at the east end of the Shadow Market.
The Critter Seller. The Bazaar spice seller has treats too.
The gem trader. The Shadow Market charm seller also pays well.
The Tailor.
The cook in the school kitchen.
The trainer in the Dojo.

services.what: Fishing rod, sell fish, better rods
services.how: The Old Fisher. Better rods cost wood and gold.
The Wandering Tinker by the waystone in the Frozen Peaks. A second Tinker works in the Desert Bazaar.
Snowy pines in the Frozen Peaks give 2 wood each. Use wood for weapon orders, rods, repairs or sell it.
Beat Gnarl the Treant in the Forest. The axe hurts him the most.
Calm Granite, the stone guardian, deep in the Caves.
Beat the Bat Queen at her roost in the Crystal Caverns. It also lights a much bigger circle in the dark.
Behind the Bat Queen's roost (bottom-right of the Caverns). It opens once she is beaten.
Top-right corner of the Caverns, by the sign about a cold draft. Needs the Crystal Lantern.
Beat the Yeti in the snowy room at the north of the Frozen Peaks.
Calm the Sea Serpent in the Sunken Ruins. The sandy archway in the Caverns then lets you into the Desert.
Beat the Scorpion King in the Desert.

services.what: Learn to cook and brew (COOK/BREW tabs in the bag)
services.how: Explore all 8 chambers of the Caves, then talk to Surveyor Tam by the cave mouth in the Quarry.
In the Hidden Vault, the last chamber at the back of the Caves. Two rock piles block the tunnel: bring a pickaxe.

services.what: Free the six fairies (a gift from each)
services.how: Beat the thorn guardian beside each cage: red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple.
Free all six fairies, then beat the Rainbow Fairy in the middle of the Hollow.
